instruction: Founder trust remains NOT_ENROLLED. Do not run the Node-only enrollment CLI as a key-generation step: it exits with FOUNDER_KEYSTORE_UNAVAILABLE and creates no key or candidate. Enrollment requires a platform-backed, non-extractable keystore on a Founder-controlled device, a challenge-signing proof of possession, independent custody verification, and a separate explicit Founder decision. No public JWK is trusted until that process is complete. authorizationEvent fails closed with FOUNDER_NOT_ENROLLED.
